# ErrorState

Explains a failed load in a panel: what happened, what it affects, whether retrying will help, and the one action that fixes it, keeping the last good data vis…

`SongNodes.ErrorState` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.ErrorState kind="offline" title="…" text={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.ErrorState" kind="offline" title="…" text="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (ErrorStateProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` * | `"offline" \| "timeout" \| "auth-expired" \| "not-found" \| "server" \| "validation"` | Cause; picks icon, status colour and default retry guidance. |
| `title` * | `string` | What happened, in plain words: "Tidal is slow right now". |
| `text` * | `ReactNode` | What it affects and what to do next. |
| `retryHint` | `string` | Whether retrying will help, said in words ("Retrying won't help until you reconnect"). |
| `retryHelps` | `boolean` | False when retrying cannot help (shows – instead of ↻). |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | Called by the Retry button; omit when retry cannot help. |
| `action` | `ReactNode` | Cause-specific action instead of or beside Retry ("Reconnect Tidal", "Go to saved sets"). |
| `referenceId` | `string` | Server reference ID, shown copyable for 5xx errors. |
| `fields` | `{ id: string; label: string; message: string }[]` | Fields to fix for validation errors; each links to its field. |
| `lastGood` | `{ at: Date \| string; content: ReactNode }` | Last successful data, shown under the error with its time. |
| `panel` | `boolean` | Borderless variant that fills a panel instead of sitting as a card. |
